{{PetsOnlyTrading}} {{PSX|Huge Pets}} '''Huge Pets''' are a subgroup of {{Exclusive99}} pets. They are very large compared to regular-sized pets and are some of the rarest and most expensive [[List of Pets (Pet Simulator 99)|pets]] in the game alongside [[Titanic Pets (Pet Simulator 99)|Titanic]] and [[Gargantuan Pets (Pet Simulator 99)|Gargantuan]] pets. Huge Pets can be obtained through [[Merch Codes (Pet Simulator 99)|real money]], [[Exclusive Pets Egg (Pet Simulator 99)|exclusive eggs]], from opening [[List of Eggs (Pet Simulator 99)|eggs]] and [[Giftboxes (Pet Simulator 99)|gifts]], and as a reward from various events. == Overview == Unlike normal pets, Huge Pets do not have fixed damage values. Instead, their strength automatically scales relative to the player's strongest stat pet. This allows Huge Pets to remain viable throughout progression, making them significantly more useful than ordinary pets over long periods of gameplay. Huge Pets also feature leveling systems, enchant slots, charms, and multiple variants such as Golden, Rainbow, and Shiny forms. Certain variants provide additional damage multipliers and are considerably rarer than standard Huge Pets. Many Huge Pets have unique animations, oversized models, and exclusive effects. Some are based on existing pets, while others feature entirely original designs. == Pet Power == * '''Huge Pets''' will always deal more damage than the player's strongest stat pet. (Only one strong stat pet is required.) * '''Evolved Huge Pets''' are special variants that deal the '''same''' amount of damage as standard Huge Pets. * '''Golden Huge Pets''' deal '''+0.3x''' more damage than normal Huge Pets. * '''Rainbow Huge Pets''' deal '''+0.9x''' more damage than normal Huge Pets. * '''Shiny Huge Pets''' deal '''+1x''' more damage than normal Huge Pets. Huge Pets gain additional damage boosts as they level up. == Pet Damage Formula == Huge Pet damage is based on the following formula: X \times (1 + Y + Z) Where: * X = Damage of the player's strongest stat pet * Y = Bonus damage from the Huge Pet's level * Z = Bonus damage from variants such as Golden, Rainbow, or Shiny For example, if a player's strongest stat pet deals 5,000,000 damage and they own a Rainbow Huge Pet with a level bonus of +30.2% damage: 5,000,000 \times (1 + 0.302 + 0.9) = 11,010,000 This results in the Huge Pet dealing 11,010,000 damage. {{PS99DamageProgression}} ==Level Progression== The experience required to progress between each level increases geometrically by a factor of \sqrt[7]{2} (approximately 10.4%). This means that the required experience to level a pet doubles about every 7 levels. Consequently, level 92 marks the halfway point to level 99. Reaching level 99 requires '''13,034,431''' total experience points. The total experience needed to reach level L is given by the function:
XP(L)=\left\lfloor \frac{1}{4}\sum_{n=1}^{L-1}\left\lfloor n+300 \times \sqrt[7]{2^{n}} \right\rfloor \right\rfloor The amount of experience required to progress from level \text{L} to \text{L}+1 can be approximated with following:
XP(L+1)-XP(L)\approx 75\times \sqrt[7]{2^{L}} {{PS99LevelProgression}} == Trivia == * Huge Pets are larger than standard pets but smaller than [[Titanic Pets (Pet Simulator 99)|Titanic Pets]]. * Huge Pets automatically scale with the player's strongest stat pet. * Some Huge Pets are only obtainable through real-life merchandise purchases. * Rainbow Shiny Huge Pets are among the rarest Huge Pet variants. * Certain Huge Pets have existed since earlier Pet Simulator games and later returned in ''Pet Simulator 99''. == List of Huge Pets (By year) == |-|2023= {{PS992023HugePets}} |-|2024= {{PS992024HugePets}} |-|2025= {{PS992025HugePets}} |-|2026= {{PS992026HugePets}} [[Category:Pet Simulator 99]] [[Category:Huge Pet]] [[Category:Pet]] [[Category:Limited]] [[Category:Exclusive]]
